Une mobilisation citoyenne pour la prote: A citizen mobilization for the protection of ecosystems
Dans le cadre de sa stratégie RSE (Respo: As part of its CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) strategy, Ooredoo Algeria is stepping up its environmental actions by organizing a dual cleanup operation in Skikda. This initiative, scheduled to coincide with World Environment Day (June 5, 2026), is in line with the group's ongoing sustainability commitments.
L'opération se déroulera simultanément s: The operation will take place simultaneously at two iconic sites in the wilaya of Skikda:
La plage de Larbi Ben M'hidi : Un littor: Larbi Ben M'hidi beach: A coastline frequently exposed to plastic waste and litter, requiring urgent intervention to preserve marine biodiversity.
La forêt de Felfela : Un écosystème fore: Felfela forest: A forest ecosystem threatened by abandoned waste and human activities, the restoration of which is crucial to maintaining ecological balance.
Pour faciliter la participation du publi: To facilitate public participation, Ooredoo Algeria is providing round-trip transportation from the Hôtel Belle Vue, located in the heart of Skikda. Volunteers are invited to gather at 8:00 AM in front of the establishment, before heading to the intervention sites at 8:30 AM.

Ooredoo Algérie, l'un des trois opérateu: Ooredoo Algeria, one of the country's three major telecom operators alongside Mobilis (Algérie Télécom) and Djezzy (Optimum Télécom Algérie), has already conducted several similar initiatives across Algeria. These actions add to its environmental awareness programs, such as electronic waste recycling and reducing the carbon footprint of its infrastructure.
